title: RenderingGen Job V1
description: Envelope contract for a RenderingGen render job. One job corresponds to one video SEGMENT (never a single overlay): the render_plan contains every layer of the segment — base video, phrases, keywords, images and animations — so Chronon3d composes them in a single pass. RenderingGen is the orchestrator; the renderable content is a chronon.render-plan.v1 document produced upstream by PipelineGen, and RenderingGen forwards it unchanged (writing it to plan.json) together with a materialized asset root.

id.description: Job identifier, e.g. video-983 (one per segment).

schema.description: Envelope schema name, following the same schema+version convention as the Chronon3d render-plan schema.

render_plan.description: Either the semantic overlay-plan.v1 emitted by PipelineGen (compiled by RenderingGen) or the legacy/concrete chronon.render-plan.v1 document (passed through unchanged).

assets.description: Assets referenced by the render_plan, addressed by content hash and the logical path they must be materialized at inside the job workspace.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the asset bytes in the artifact store (used for L1/L2/L3 resolution).

logical_path.description: Path relative to the job assets root where the asset must be materialized, e.g. videos/base.mp4 or images/apple.png. This is the path the render_plan layer sources/asset fields refer to.
